$comment: Skills generated by src/codegen/generate-agent-tools.ts into .claude/skills/<name>/. Each section is extracted from the repository (docs, CLAUDE.md, module docs, package.json, the bun lsp sources); only the descriptions are written here.

skills.name: cpp-bun
skills.description: C++ in the Bun fork: JavaScriptCore bindings in src/jsc/bindings, JS classes and .classes.ts codegen, exception scopes (BUN_JSC_validateExceptionChecks), GC and iso subspaces, Rust and C++ interop. Use when editing the runtime's .cpp/.h files or their Rust counterparts.

skills.name: webkit
skills.description: The WebKit/JavaScriptCore fork behind the Bun fork (aphrody-labs/WebKit, prebuilt from oven-sh/WebKit): the pinned WEBKIT_VERSION, building JSC locally with `bun run build:local`, patching JSC and publishing prebuilts, rebasing on upstream WebKit. Use when a change needs JSC, WTF or bmalloc sources.

sections.heading: Building WebKit locally + Debug mode of JSC

skills.name: win32
skills.description: Win32, COM, WinRT and NT in the Bun fork: bun:windows, bun:winrt, bun:winui, bun msvc and bun winmd, the Rust modules behind them (src/runtime/windows, src/windows_sys), HANDLE ownership, wide strings, HRESULT/NTSTATUS errors, the MSVC toolchain and Windows debugging. Use for any Windows-specific code or build.

sections.heading: 3. SEH / unwind x64, vectored handlers, WER, Event Log

skills.name: linux-kernel
skills.description: Linux kernel work for the Bun fork: bun:linux (namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, io_uring probe, eBPF, netlink, perf_event), bun_sys syscall wrappers, the /dev/bun_accel driver of the aphrody-labs/linux fork (Kbuild, Kconfig, checkpatch, selftests), clangd with compile_commands.json, WSL kernel and Alpine images. Use for kernel patches or Linux-only runtime code.

skills.name: bun-apis
skills.description: Which Bun API replaces which Node.js module or npm package in an application run by the Bun fork, and how complete the Node.js compatibility is. Use before adding a dependency or writing Node-style code.

skills.name: n2b
skills.description: Move a Node.js project to Bun with n2b (`bun n2b`): safe and behavior-changing rewrites, reports, project migration. Use when converting Node code, scripts or package.json to Bun.

skills.name: bun-deps
skills.description: Read the installed sources and docs of a project's dependencies (npm packages, Cargo crates, vendored libraries) at their exact versions, and digest a directory into one prompt, with the `bun mcp` tools git_ingest and deps_*. Use instead of fetching a library's repository from the web.
